implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): the owner-operator holds every role and there is no bookkeeper. The bank requires a one-time code before a payee is added, and POL-01 9.3 requires payment changes or new bank details received by email or text to be confirmed by phone with a known number. The tax preparer (CPA) works from the accounting exports each year for Schedule C.
evidence: EV-015 (bank payee settings); POL-01 9.3; EV-011 (shared export folder)

implementation_statement: The owner will create a standard user account on the laptop for daily work and keep the administrator account for installs only, and will give the planned second alert contact a view-only SYS-01 role (2026-10-15).

implementation_statement: All remote access to the smokehouse controller and the gateway goes through the vendors' cloud apps; no device has an inbound port open to the internet (router check 2026-07-29). evidence: EV-SC-7 (router port check); EV-006 (SYS-02 app settings)
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.AA-05 (benchmark); 9 CFR 424.21 and 318.6(a) via 303.1(b)(1) (cook and cure integrity)

implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): the P07 plan states openly that independence is limited, because the owner designed, operates, and assessed the controls with help from the on-call IT technician. POL-01 4.4 requires the IT technician to review the evidence at least every second year. The cold-chain vendor's SOC 2 Type 2 report, reviewed 2026-07-30, covers the vendor's inherited controls. Gap: the first outside review has not taken place.
evidence: P07 assessment plan; POL-01 4.4; P09 vendor review; EV-005 (vendor SOC 2 report)

implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): there is no change board, so under CM-3(g) the owner is the change control element. POL-01 5.7 keeps remote program editing off, so cook programs change only at the controller panel. The programs are printed in the shop binder, and POL-01 5.8 has the owner compare the smokehouse program list against the binder each month. SYS-01 logs every set point change. Gap: the monthly check starts with the AU-6 review from 2026-09.
evidence: POL-01 5.7 and 5.8; shop binder; EV-003 (SYS-01 activity log)
